heroHeading: Essential Services. Right Where You Need Them.
heroDescription: Discover essential public services in your locality through a simple, accessible and community-powered digital directory.
aboutProblem: Residents and visitors often face significant friction locating reliable, up-to-date information regarding essential public facilities in their neighborhoods — such as 24/7 pharmacies, accessible municipal sanitation blocks, police beat chowkis, and government dispensaries.
aboutObjective: To digitally survey, geolocate, and catalog essential civic facilities across surveyed localities, presenting them through an open, accessible web portal and interactive digital map that empowers community members and identifies service accessibility deficits.
aboutMethodology: Select target geographic locality and boundary wards
Conduct structured field visits and on-ground reconnaissance
Identify and geocode essential public facilities
Collect verified contact details, operational timings and facilities
Conduct community engagement survey among local residents
Verify gathered data against municipal records and spot-checks
Digitize datasets and structure open schemas
Develop accessible responsive web application and digital map
Analyze collected survey data and service spatial distribution
Prepare comprehensive CEP report with civic recommendations
